entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Inner Sea Gods
entity_raw.definition_raw:
Your positive energy makes trailblazers of those you heal.

Prerequisite(s): Channel energy 3d6, worshiper of a deity of stars or travelers.

Benefit(s): Once per day when you channel positive energy, you can cause healed creatures to be unimpeded by difficult terrain for a number of minutes equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum 1 minute).
